title: 📱 Huawei Unveils Its Thinnest Phone Yet: Mate 90 Air!
body: 📱 Huawei Unveils Its Thinnest Phone Yet: Mate 90 Air!
Huawei unveiled the Mate 90 Air, which it says is its thinnest and lightest phone ever, launching officially on November 24 alongside its foldable Mate X8.
The phone comes in a two-tone, dual-material design in cherry pink and bronze, and runs on a new Kirin chip and HarmonyOS 7.
The company has not yet announced the dimensions, weight, battery, camera, or price — all the details will be revealed on launch day.
Are you waiting for the full announcement? Or is the design alone enough for you?
